title: Connecting the Dots Between ME/CFS, HSD/hEDS, Abnormal Fascia, Lymphatic and Glymphatic System Impairment, and Craniocervical Instability
content: This hypothesis paper encourages a comprehensive approach to studying Myalgic Encephalomyelitis/Chronic Fatigue Syndrome (ME/CFS) that connects the dots between Hypermobility Spectrum Disorders (HSD) and Hypermobile Ehlers Danlos Syndrome (hEDS), fascial abnormalities, impaired lymphatic and glymphatic systems, spinal conditions like craniocervical instability and Chiari Malformation, and ME/CFS.  In particular, this paper encourages more research into biomechanical processes that may contribute to ME/CFS and ME/CFS-like presentations of Long COVID among individuals with HSD/hEDS.
